imperial.description: Imperial HEP HTCondor. Memory is per slot, so a job needing more memory than one slot provides must request more cores.
imperial.max_cpus_per_job_comment: Not a site limit; the farm allows more. Needing more than two cores means the memory per job is too high, and the work should be split differently rather than given a bigger slot. Raise this deliberately if you want to trade that away.
